items.title: 61521_David Albert Francis oral history interview
items.q: At the time I got married to her, I was Dinah Shore's personal drummer

ctx.x: Besides that, and all this recording and all the other things you'd done, plus the nightclubs you played with: Slim Gaillard and Della Reese and who else here?
Oh, Dinah Shore, Polly Bergen, Paul Anka, George Maharis, Joe Williams ...

Beautiful. Man, I can't tell you that I can hardly think of anybody you missed in going around here. This list of yours here is just unbelievable; all the records you made, all of the hit records you made, the jazz records, these things you made with Roy Eldridge.
